card.name: First-person or author-byline word starts
card.fires_on: Short pieces right before a name or drug name, such as first-person "I'm"/"I am", the "my" in mycophenolate, or author-credit spots like "By:" and "About the author".

modes.label: First-person intro
modes.description: "I" with 'm or am where a writer introduces themselves or their own work.
modes.example: I<<'m>> Dr. Cindy Haines of HealthDay

modes.label: Author byline
modes.description: Initials, punctuation or the word author just before an author's name.
modes.example: Author: Kellie C<<.>> Ellis Could some common online activities actually

modes.label: Start of mycophenolate
modes.description: The opening "my" piece of mycophenolic acid or mycophenolate.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly pushes odd name-like pieces and suppresses Chinese writer-opinion words like "we think" and "suggest".
card.plain: It lights up where a writer names themselves or is credited, and in the start of the drug name mycophenolate.
